name: caddy-cloudflare
why: xcaddy build with Cloudflare DNS plugin for ACME DNS-01 wildcard certs
remove_when: never — Cloudflare DNS plugin is not in upstream Caddy

name: cadvisor
why: v0.56.2 fixes Docker 29+ crash but isn't published as a container image

name: dagu-ops
why: Dagu operations scheduler + restic + rclone + Docker CLI for homelab automation
remove_when: never — ops tooling layer is always needed on top of Dagu

name: mcp-auth-proxy
why: Built from source on our base-images (golang:1.25-bookworm builder + alpine:3.23 runtime). Alpine runtime is required so the homelab compose pattern can wrap the entrypoint in /bin/sh -c to materialize the Postgres DSN from Docker secrets (see alxleo/homelab#401). No code patches as of v2.9.1 — upstream merged the VARCHAR(255) fix (#111).
remove_when: upstream sigbit/mcp-auth-proxy ships an image with /bin/sh and *_FILE env-var support (then we can switch back to upstream and drop the local build)

name: mcp-git
why: Custom Dockerfile with git+ssh deps and Docker secret injection entrypoint
remove_when: upstream publishes an official Docker image with HTTP transport

name: mcp-reddit
why: Custom FastMCP server over the Arctic-Shift archive — Reddit's Responsible Builder Policy (Nov 2025) closed self-serve OAuth creds, killing the npm reddit-mcp-server backend
remove_when: Reddit reopens self-serve Data API credentials for personal use (then reconsider the OAuth npm server)

name: mcp-substack
why: Custom MCP server — no existing Substack MCP supports authenticated subscriber content
remove_when: never — custom server wrapping substack-api library

name: pihole-exporter
why: Thin wrapper around upstream exporter to support Docker secret injection instead of env_file
remove_when: upstream supports *_FILE or Docker secret ingestion natively

name: pr-reviewer
why: AI-assisted PR review pipeline: Claude + Gemini + Codex reviewers with verification/scoring. Tagged with github.sha per build (no static version tag; use :latest as the stable reference).
remove_when: never — custom reviewer pipeline with no upstream equivalent

name: semaphore
why: Semaphore UI + homelab tools (sops, age, dig, curl, jq, rsync) for Ansible playbooks
remove_when: never — homelab tooling layer is always needed on top of upstream
